name: takeaway
description: Structured feedback extraction from skill/tool usage. Interviews the user, distills observations into portable principles, and produces two files — a project-specific evidence retrospective and a tool-agnostic lessons document an improving agent can consume.

interface.shortDescription: Distill portable lessons from skill or tool usage
interface.longDescription: Interview the user about a usage session, capture concrete evidence, then distill it into portable, tool-agnostic lessons an improving agent can apply anywhere.
defaultPrompt: Extract lessons from using a skill or workflow
Run a takeaway retrospective on a tool
Distill portable, tool-agnostic lessons from this session
